title: Glass Cockpit Displays & HUD
summary: All-glass instrument panel layout featuring a wide-angle Head-Up Display (HUD), Integrated Control Panel (ICP), four reconfigurable color LCDs (one 8×8 in primary MFD, three 6.5×6.5 in secondary MFDs), and two 3×4 in up-front displays, rendered with generic educational graphics only.
role: Presents flight, navigation, engine, and tactical situational awareness to the pilot.

modelingNotes.proportionReference: Lockheed Martin Code One ('The New Front Office'): 1× 8×8 in, 3× 6.5×6.5 in, 2× 3×4 in LCDs

specs.label: Reconfigurable MFDs
specs.value: 4 color LCDs: one 8 × 8 in (0.203 m) primary + three 6.5 × 6.5 in (0.165 m) secondary
specs.source: Lockheed Martin Code One — The New Front Office (John Kent, 2006)
specs.snippet: "four reconfigurable liquid crystal displays — three 6.5 and one 8"

specs.label: Up-Front Displays (UFDs)
specs.value: 2 non-reconfigurable 3 × 4 in (0.076 × 0.102 m) displays flanking the ICP
specs.source: Lockheed Martin Code One — The New Front Office (John Kent, 2006)
specs.snippet: "two non reconfigurable 3- by 4-inch up front displays"

specs.source: Classified; explorer shows generic educational gauges only
